tools.name: base_token_check
tools.description: Base token safety check before you buy or accept a token: simulates a real buy, wallet-to-wallet transfer and sell on the deepest Uniswap v2/v3 or Aerodrome WETH pool, and reports honeypot (sell reverts), buy/sell/transfer tax, liquidity depth, LP burn share, proxy/upgradeability, owner and privileg
